info.title: link and dummy data
info.description: TailWise QA Sandbox API Documentation. Contains mock endpoints, deliberate QA test bugs, and dummy data schemas.

post.description: Authenticates a user against mock database or MongoDB. Note: Contains a deliberate QA case-insensitive password comparison bug.
Registers a new user. Note: Contains deliberate QA bugs (email validation is bypassed, password lengths > 8 characters are silently truncated to 8).

get.description: Retrieves list of all users. In MongoDB mode, password field is omitted.

put.description: Updates a user's role. Note: Contains a deliberate target-mismatch QA bug where it always modifies the first user in the DB/array instead of the requested ID.

404.description: User database is empty or not found

delete.description: Deletes a user by search query ID parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique User ID to delete

get.description: Retrieves the list of animals available for adoption. Note: Contains a deliberate QA bug that lists all animals, including those already adopted.

post.description: Creates a new animal profile for adoption.

Submits an adoption application for a specific animal. Note: Contains deliberate QA bugs: allows dates in the past, and throws a simulated 500 NullPointerException crash if the animal's status is already 'adopted'.

200.description: Adoption request submitted and animal marked adopted

500.description: Simulated application crash (NullPointerException if animal already adopted) or server error

error.example: CRITICAL_CRASH: NullPointerException inside AnimalMatchingService. Match recommendations failed because animal is already bound to another owner account!

stack.example:
Error: CRITICAL_CRASH: NullPointerException inside AnimalMatchingService...
    at POST (route.ts:39:15)...

post.description: Submits a donation for a specific cause. Note: Contains deliberate QA bugs: allows negative donation amounts, and mapping bug where cause 'General Welfare Fund' is saved as 'General Fund'.

get.description: Retrieves the list of feedback left by users.

post.description: Submits feedback. Note: Contains deliberate QA bugs: accepting rating out of range [1-5], censors the word 'bad' to 'excellent', and throws a simulated server crash (500) if the comment contains the word 'crash'.

comment.example: This service is bad, I want to trigger a crash test.

500.description: Simulated server crash (if comment has 'crash') or internal error

error.example: CRITICAL: NullPointerException at FeedbackCensorshipProcessor.java:42. String reference is null.

get.description: Retrieves the list of reported emergency rescue incidents.

post.description: Reports a new stray animal in distress. Note: Contains deliberate QA bugs: swaps latitude and longitude parameters when storing, allows blank location text, and stores image string as corrupted placeholder if base64/url size exceeds 2MB (length > 500k chars).

description.example: Injured kitten trapped in a drainage pipe.

post.description: Marks an incident as resolved. Note: Contains a deliberate QA off-by-one bug where it resolves the NEXT incident in the list (index + 1) rather than the clicked one.

message.example: Resolved incident of Dog at Central Park, NY (GPS: -71.0589, 42.3601) (requested: i1, actual resolved: i2)

post.description: Classifies an animal image based on its filename. Note: Contains a deliberate classification rules bug (checks if the filename contains the letter 'd' to determine if it is a dog).
Accepts and logs user actions on the server console.

get.description: Retrieves the list of products matching a query. Note: Contains a deliberate case-sensitive search QA bug.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-sensitive query parameter to match products by name

post.description: Performs checkout of cart products. Note: Contains a deliberate QA bug allowing negative quantities which increases stock and calculates a negative total price.

get.description: Searches vet clinics by city. Note: Selecting 'Suburbs' city will result in zero hospitals, triggering a deliberate client-side TypeError crash.

post.description: Books an appointment. Note: Contains a deliberate target swap QA bug where it always schedules the appointment with the first clinic in the database regardless of the requested clinicId.

message.example: Appointment successfully booked with City Animal Hospital!

post.description: Restores mock database store variables to default seeded values.

comment.example: Great pet application platform! Very easy to use.

description.example: Stray dog with a broken front leg near Central Park.
Nutritious high-protein kibble for active adult dogs.

error.example: Error message detailing what went wrong.
